It's a race condition between ATTACH PARTITION and DROP_RANGE:
https://pastila.nl/?00071312/5b4d309c34ab70721bf7fca85c64ccfe#hg9RazYci3tKA+MgFsT45Q==

DROP_RANGE should have removed the part from zk, but it was not active yet at the moment of calling `removePartsInRangeFromWorkingSetAndGetPartsToRemoveFromZooKeeper`

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
More logs: https://pastila.nl/?003d5567/71c4deb8e5ce8439b19321f60766ba93#jUwRq2UCMde7kBZBPIlqBA==

We have protection from this: `dropAllPartsInPartitions`/`addOpsToDropAllPartsInPartition`/`clearLockedBlockNumbersInPartition` cancels committing parts that are going to be dropped by that `DROP_RANGE` by removing the block numbers from zk. And `ReplicatedMergeTreeSinkImpl::commitPart` fails to commit such parts ([code](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/blob/47ff13056f0a6dbff8c61389f840f4c55216b8a8/src/Storages/MergeTree/ReplicatedMergeTreeSink.cpp#L925-L929))

But we have an optimization for duplicate parts:
```
2023.10.25 21:56:52.815775 [ 3022 ] {7e1a0781-182b-4473-912e-a30f11ce6584} <Information> test_bcyivuz0.alter_table1 (a8336085-c547-4dac-8e13-cbea2e4e0094) (Replicated OutputStream): Block with ID all_CFE4743C4144A7CD2129FEF615DD9959 already exists on other replicas as part all_15_15_0; will write it locally with that name.
```

And it bypasses the protection because it inserts a part without allocating a block number: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/blob/47ff13056f0a6dbff8c61389f840f4c55216b8a8/src/Storages/MergeTree/ReplicatedMergeTreeSink.cpp#L758-L802

I have no idea how to fix this but to remove the optimization.
